tagline: Structural steel — detailed, fabricated and erected across Victoria.

services.title: Detailing
services.description: Shop drawings and 3D modelling that catch problems on screen, not on site. Every connection resolved before a single length of steel is cut.

services.title: Steelwork
services.description: Structural members, connections and general steelwork for commercial, industrial and residential builds — supplied to spec and on programme.

services.title: Fabrication
services.description: In-house fabrication with certified welders. Beams, columns, trusses, stairs and balustrades cut, drilled and welded to AS/NZS standards.

services.title: Erection
services.description: Our own crews stand the steel we make. Craneage, rigging and bolting handled end-to-end, with the site left ready for the next trade.
